form:FormGroup.label: Priority
form:FormGroup.helpText: The priority of the new processor filters, from 1 to 100. Filters with a higher priority are processed first. Default is 10. Ignored when automatic priority is ticked and the pipeline has an existing filter.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: 1 to 100, higher runs first. Used unless automatic priority applies.

form:FormGroup.label: Min Create Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: Only process streams created at or after this time, in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-01-31T00:00:00.000Z. Leave blank for no lower limit.

form:FormGroup.label: Max Create Time
form:FormGroup.helpText: Only process streams created at or before this time, in ISO 8601 format. Leave blank for no upper limit. Set to now when specific streams are selected or Reprocess data is changed.
